info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Syndicated Loan Management API
info.description: This API enables efficient management of syndicated loans, allowing users to update details and terms of existing loans. It is designed for financial institutions and banking professionals who require real-time modifications to loan agreements. By utilizing this API, developers can streamline the process of updating loan parameters, ensuring compliance and accuracy in financial reporting. Typical use cases include adjusting interest rates, changing loan amounts, or modifying borrower information.

patch.summary: Update details of a syndicated loan.
patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the details of a specified syndicated loan, identified by its unique loan ID. You can modify various attributes of the loan as needed to reflect the latest information or changes in terms.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the details of a syndicated loan identified by LOAN-500045. Ensure that you provide the necessary fields to accurately reflect the current status and parameters of the loan.
